style: Four equal square scenes per sheet. Point-up hexagon, bevelled rarity rim, dark inset and a short, legible 3D gym vignette. No lettering or rank plaque.

stories.repertoire.familiar_days: A familiar gym door recognizes a key, then a sneaker, then two gym partners greet each other. An ice-blue frame in all three issued scenes.
stories.start.first_workout: A blue training sneaker character and its mustard-yellow sofa. I: the sneaker leaves the sofa carrying its towel, ice-silver frame. II: it unpacks a small duffel in a locker, electric-blue frame. III: it collects a permanent gym pass, violet frame. The unused fourth panel shows the sofa coming to watch.
stories.signature.remix: A gym weight plate is a vinyl record and a tiny dumbbell DJ changes a single record. Swap one record; mix two on a desk; send a record on tour; conduct a whole gym DJ night.
stories.discovery.club_host: A kettlebell is a miniature club doorman with a velvet rope, introducing previously unacquainted gym equipment. One guest, then a little guestbook, three regulars, then a large reunion.
stories.calendar.format_relay: A rolled teal gym mat is a relay baton handed from a dumbbell to a stopwatch on separate training days. First handover, a second runner, team holding batons, finish line. No humans.
stories.discovery.old_and_new: A familiar blue shoe welcomes a new yellow training shoe to the lockers. Show greeting, showing the locker, exchanging laces, then welcoming an even newer shoe together.
stories.discovery.seasoned: A travelling kettlebell and four seasons. It tries a scarf under a snowflake, then a spring shoot umbrella, a sunhat, finally has a suitcase of season souvenirs including a leaf.
stories.signature.reunited_pairs: Two distinct kettlebell friends, one blue and one orange; bump handles, share a bench, take a selfie, then pose for a reunion portrait.
stories.signature.same_setlist: Tiny gym equipment as a returning band. A dumbbell guitarist with a set list, two encores, familiar band on a stage, a joyful sold-out mini concert.
stories.signature.familiar_only: A gym regular kettlebell and a friendly locker. A familiar key fits, it has its own mug, then slippers on its bench, finally a tiny framed family photo of gym objects.
stories.signature.trio: A trio band of stopwatch, kettlebell and rolled mat. First sharing one microphone, then a small drum kit, a marimba rehearsal, then a brass band finale. Make all three recognizable.
stories.return.rediscovered: A dusty old teal kettlebell exercise is rediscovered: opened storage trunk, layer of dust wiped, vintage photo reunion, treasured object on a proud gym museum pedestal.
stories.return.homecoming: A pair of training shoes arrives home from a trip. Tiny open duffel at entrance, familiar mat welcome, kettle offering tea in the locker room, then a very warm welcome party.
stories.calendar.both_halves: Two halves of a monthly planner are a pair of hinged doors with a sneaker. Two flaps meet; side-by-side calendar pages high five; two halves span a gap; pages flourish together.
stories.calendar.month_bridge: A small bridge joins two distinct monthly calendar sheets with a training shoe crossing. First a simple footbridge, then a stamped ticket, twin-arch bridge, grand border crossing.
stories.calendar.season_turns: A gym locker changing seasonal accessories. Wool hat and leaf, spring umbrella with summer visor, turning seasonal display wheel, full wardrobe for four seasons.
stories.calendar.four_colours: A little Ferris wheel has four gondolas with one snowflake, flower, sun and leaf. One complete circle, boarding another circle, glowing fairground, wheel above a tiny gym.
stories.duet.bodyweight_machine: A blue training shoe character and a silver dumbbell are partners. Shake hands, share a bench, make a double act, take a bow together.
stories.duet.machine_stretch: A barbell greets a rolled purple stretching mat. The barbell rolls out the mat, relaxes on it, mat and iron practice as partners, then mat presents the barbell with a velvet cushion.
stories.duet.machine_timed: A dumbbell and a blue stopwatch. First a handshake, then a ticking practice meet, synchronised duet, finally a tiny clock tower topped by a dumbbell.
stories.duet.bodyweight_stretch: A barefoot blue shoe and a long flexible exercise mat. The mat holds the door, they share a floor, the mat curls into a hammock, they enjoy a quiet mat studio.
stories.duet.bodyweight_timed: A runner's blue sneaker and a friendly stopwatch. They meet at a track, exchange a wink, share a lane, then the watch crosses the finish as the shoe applauds.
stories.duet.stretch_timed: An hourglass and a rolled stretching mat. The mat catches a grain, they set up side by side, they share a parasol, then make a tiny stretch studio.
stories.calendar.bodyweight_weeks: A walking sneaker with a small weekly desk calendar. One small diary, a stack of week pages, a shelf of weeks, then a thick calendar balanced on the shoe.
stories.calendar.machine_weeks: A dumbbell operating the workshop weekly time clock. Punching a simple blank card, clipping it in a row, the workshop rack, a tiny wall of calendar cards.
stories.calendar.stretch_weeks: A little cat on a lavender mat tracks its stretches on a weekly tear-off calendar. One week page, pawprint stamp, stack of pages, cozy yoga studio.
stories.calendar.timed_weeks: A walking alarm clock collects weekly calendar pages at the gym: one receipt, neat hanging file, box of weeks, a cuckoo emerges with a calendar page.
stories.discovery.bodyweight_regulars: A small gym octopus performs different bodyweight exercises on a blue mat: squat, plank, wall sit, then happy tentacles flipping illustrated exercise cards.
stories.discovery.machine_regulars: A little robot curator collects familiar machines. Polish a bar, arrange a cable attachment, open a small display, host a vivid gym equipment museum.
stories.discovery.stretch_regulars: A gym cat collects familiar stretching poses: unfurling a mat, selecting a strap, comparing pose cards, hosting a small cat stretching class.
stories.discovery.timed_regulars: An hourglass schoolteacher meeting familiar timed exercises: greets one stopwatch, points to pose cards, teaches three timers, conducts a choir of clocks.
stories.calendar.season_0: Winter training visits. A turquoise sneaker next to mittens, a snowman with a towel, a snowy gym doorway, a polar bear checking its gym bag.
stories.calendar.season_1: Spring training visits. A sprout beside a sneaker, a dumbbell watering can, a flowering gym mat, a little garden of blooming sports equipment.
stories.calendar.season_2: Summer training visits. A dumbbell in a panama hat, rolled towel by a sun umbrella, a beach chair for gym kit, then a sunny sandcastle gym.
stories.calendar.season_3: Autumn training visits. Amber maple leaf on sneaker, a little umbrella in a locker, a wheelbarrow of leaves, a maple tree wearing gym shoes.
stories.discovery.crossroads: Two different jigsaw pieces are gym partners, a small weight plate and a dumbbell. First they click into place, then invite a third piece, make a map of connections, finally form a gym team puzzle.
stories.discovery.encore: A blue sneaker gets called back for an encore, with a golden concert ticket. At stage door, taking a bow, running the little ticket booth, then applauded by rolled exercise mats.
stories.calendar.weekend_guest: A gym desk calendar character swaps a work briefcase for sunglasses. Friday briefcase and Saturday glasses; stowing briefcase on a shelf; gym mat opens like a picnic rug; a tiny beach in a locker.
stories.signature.bookends: Two sturdy dumbbells are bookends. First replace the middle notebook, then swap a little red book, arrange a library shelf of training notebooks, finally wheel in an entire book cart between the weights.
